system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

**TO:** Wattlebridge Holdings Deal Team (Project Kestrel)

### 2. PLAYBOOK DEPARTURES – CLAUSE BY CLAUSE

| **5** | **Fraud / wilful concealment / deliberate misconduct: carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non‑reliance; no waiver** | Limitations, exclusive remedy, non‑reliance apply to **“all Claims of any nature”** (cl. 9.3/12.8/20.5) | **Fraud carve‑out absent.** Seller seeks to cap even fraudulent conduct. | **Insert express fraud/wilful misconduct carve‑out** overriding every limitation, basket, time‑bar, exclusive‑remedy, non‑reliance clause. Letter 1.1–1.2) | **Blanket deemed disclosure** shifts burden to Buyer to find needles in haystack; no fair‑disclosure standard. | **Delete general disclosure clauses.** Require **specific, document‑by‑document disclosure** with fair‑disclosure test (sufficient detail to identify nature/scope). Public‑register disclosure only for matters actually searched & disclosed. |
| **7** | **Buyer knowledge: delete blanket exclusions; any qualifier needs named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry; never excuse title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity** | **“Buyer shall have no claim in respect of any matter of which Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records”** (cl. 8.3) | **Blanket constructive‑knowledge bar** – Buyer deemed to know everything in a 2,000+ document data room; swallows title, capacity, fraud, indemnity claims. | **Strike cl. 8.3 entirely.** If Seller insists on knowledge qualifier: (a) limit to **actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals**; (b) exclude title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnities, tax, IP; (c) add Seller knowledge definition (named persons + reasonable enquiry). |
| **8** | **Bluefen: effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied BEFORE Completion; reasonable endeavours insufficient** | **Reasonable endeavours only; consent “satisfied on delivery of written consent”** (cl. 3/6.3) | **No pre‑Completion certainty** that Bluefen’s change‑control conditions (cl. 11.3) are met. | **9** | **Riverlark: current payout, direct repayment from Completion funds, effective security releases; post‑completion release needs irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval** | **Release “following Completion”** (cl. 2/7) – no payoff at Completion, no security discharge evidence | **AUD 3.2M debt remains outstanding at Completion**; Buyer inherits secured creditor risk. Seller provides **irrevocable undertaking + executed discharges** at Completion. Any post‑completion release needs **Amelia Frost written approval** (not yet sought). |
